conditions.label: Hostile Environment
conditions.description: Inflicts HP damage per connected biome cell unless protected by an active status.

conditions.label: Regenerating Waters
conditions.description: Restores HP per connected biome cell up to a capped ratio.

conditions.label: Abundant Resources
conditions.description: Doubles resources gained from exploration and gather actions on the cell.

conditions.label: Open Ground
conditions.description: Allows diagonal movement from this cell.

conditions.label: Swift Path
conditions.description: Improves movement from this cell by allowing enhanced traversal.

conditions.label: Vein of Plenty
conditions.description: Doubles minerals gained on this cell.

conditions.label: Ancient Knowledge
conditions.description: Grants bonus experience when ending the turn on this cell.

conditions.label: Cursed Ground
conditions.description: Reduces luck checks performed on this cell.

conditions.label: Enemy Level Bonus By Region
conditions.description: Scaffolding condition for world event enemy level bonus resolution.
